source_health.notes: Official HRFE RSS dispatch feed. Location is intentionally street/intersection level, not an exact person location.
Official GTFS-Realtime alerts; data licensed under the Open Government Licence — Halifax.
Official HRP releases; useful for context/corroboration but often slower than dispatch feeds.
Official HRM social updates filtered to disruption/public-safety terms. HRM directs residents to this account during emergency events.
Official traffic-event text report. Zero parsed rows can legitimately mean there are no listed HRM traffic events at collection time.
Halifax Metro and Halifax County West near-real-time public weather alert Atom feed.
Provincial active emergency events. Event dates can be less granular than dispatch sources.
Read-only community API used only as a machine-readable helper. Incident cards link to the official Nova Scotia Power outage map.
Unverified context only. Public subreddit Atom feed; community posts never upgrade an incident to confirmed status and author identities are not stored.

disclaimer: Public-information aggregator. May be delayed or incomplete. For emergencies call 911.
